description: Follows the Splice tags and bumps the pin in templates/canton-barebones.config.json.
Only that pin is managed, so the one PR Renovate can open is the Splice bump.
No schedule: with one dependency managed there is nothing to batch, so the PR opens as soon as a release shows up.

customManagers.description: The Splice pin in the scaffolded config template.

packageRules.description: Splice also publishes non-release tags like next-cilr. Only plain X.Y.Z is a release.
prBodyNotes: `changeset-check` fails until this PR has a changeset. Renovate cannot add one itself, so:
npx changeset   # minor, summary: "Update Splice to {{{newValue}}}"
git add .changeset && git commit -m "chore: add changeset for Splice {{{newValue}}}" && git push
CI checks that Splice {{{newValue}}} still works with this wrapper, but it only reads files. Run `start` locally before merging to confirm the stack comes up.
